findings.summary: input_commit, subject_commit, and implementation_subject_commit are byte-identical (all 37c292efbe437e472622d6e33fa8dae640540947), satisfying the contract's same-commit handoff. Product consistency between work_head_commit d9eab8dc29d47688de3eb57bc28b891dd8af9d69 and the subject commit could not be mechanically verified via git diff (read-only inspection only), but file inspection shows the materialization commit stacks only reserved .dev-dispatch/ namespace metadata (the implement handoff JSON) on the product tip, consistent with a compliant metadata-only materialization; the deterministic seal independently verifies HEAD.

The rework resolves all three prior final-review findings. (1) The mandated complementary assertion -- a genuine new attempt without a prior REJECT stays rejected -- is added as test_a_genuine_new_attempt_without_a_prior_reject_is_rejected (tests/test_dd_replay.py:691), satisfying spec requirement 5. (2) The reported ORDER_VIOLATION is fixed: _candidate_plans (src/fleet_graph/graphs/dd_replay.py:225) now collects plans from every prior generation and orders them review-depth-first (dd_replay.py:267); _select (dd_replay.py:269) picks the first preparable one, so a replayed candidate whose inherited chain ended APPROVE-final now carries its continuous and final reviews forward (_walk dd_replay.py:345-430) rather than opening a fresh continuous-review attempt, satisfying requirement 3. (3) The major -- preferring the reviewed prefix could disable replay -- is fixed by _select's _prepare fallback to less-preferred candidates, proven by test_preferring_the_reviewed_prefix_falls_back_to_a_partial_prefix (tests/test_dd_replay.py:562).
